excerpt.zh: 扫描显示在[From.GetName]的水层之下隐藏着一个错综复杂的隧道系统。是谁创造了它们？
excerpt.en: Scans suggest an intricate system of tunnels lies hidden beneath the waters of [From.GetName]. What could have created them?

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]蓝绿色的水下分布着广泛的洞穴系统，其中似乎有数量庞大的外星智慧生物遗骸。这些陆生节肢动物在[From.GetName]表面建造了成千上万互相连通的蚁穴，在那时，该行星大部分水仍被保留在极地冰盖中。然而不断上升的行星温度（引发的水平面上升）如温水煮青蛙一般将这存续了数千年的物种灭绝，无人幸存。
texts.en: The extensive system of burrows far below the waves of [From.GetName]'s turquoise waters are the remains of a widespread population of likely sapient alien lifeforms. These land-bound arthropoids constructed thousands upon thousands of interconnected termite-like mounds on [From.GetName]'s surface, at a time when most of the planet's water was contained in polar icecaps. Rising planetary temperatures, however, slowly doomed the species that had persisted for millennia to a watery grave. None remain today.
